messages:
Maya: Weekly account health check-in for Brightline — quick snapshot (tokens + throughput).
Maya: TL;DR — WoW tokens -6%, QoQ +18%. Avg p50 latency 110ms (up 15ms WoW). Error rate 0.8% spike yesterday (was 0.2%). Spend +3% WoW.
Maya: Posting the small query I ran in case folks want the raw slices:
```sql
-- last 7 days by day
SELECT day, tokens, avg_latency_ms AS p50_latency, error_rate_pct FROM customer_metrics
WHERE customer = 'brightline' AND day >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY day;
```
Sam: saw the latency uptick around 09:30 UTC yesterday, correlates with a couple of 512-token batched jobs hitting dedicated pool.
Sam: I dug into request traces — a tail of a couple long-running decoders held the worker queues ~20s occasionally.
Diego: errors look like 429/burst throttles + a handful of 500s tied to a model reload.
Diego: 429s are primarily at 09:28-09:35 UTC, ~120 requests. 500s were 6 requests during the reload window.
Maya: thanks. Renewal risk: low overall but slight concern on spikes — Brightline is usage-driven and watches latency closely. Recommend enablement on batching + cache suggestions.
Kevin: I can push a quick enablement session next Tue. Maya, can you confirm they'd be open?
Maya: I pinged them earlier — they said "yes, likely Tue morning PT". I'll lock it after I hear back.
Sam: short-term mitigation: add a soft cap on batch size to avoid decoder queueing for requests >400 tokens. I can roll the policy to dedicated pool v2 by EOD.
Maya: action items:
• Sam -> soft cap rollout (batch size) and monitor p95 latency (due EOD).
• Diego -> follow up on 429 throttle rule (adjust burst window) and confirm retry headers.
• Kevin -> schedule enablement + share a 1-pager on batching benefits with customer.
Maya: FYI spend uptick looks tied to QoQ growth + a couple of larger experiments (A/B tests they ran last week). Not unexpected but call it out during renewal sync.
Kevin: noted, will include in renewal notes.
usage-bot: alert: throughput spike detected for customer=brightline at 2025-11-14T09:28:42Z — peak qps 48 (baseline 22).
Maya: revisiting QoQ — tokens +18% QoQ is healthy growth. If we stabilize latency and reduce error spikes they'll likely expand.
Diego: I'll capture the error windows and post a small CSV to the customer thread for transparency.
Maya: thanks team — I'll update Brightline after Sam's rollout and Diego's follow-up. If anything urgent pops up, flag in #incidents and ping me. :thumbsup:
Kevin: +1, thanks all.
